text.tspan: Breast cancer death rate in women
Reported deaths from breast cancer per 100,000 women, based on the underlying cause listed on death
Note: To allow for comparisons between countries and over time, this metric is age-standardized. All deaths in a country may not have been
registered with a cause of death. Comparisons may be affected by differences in measurement.
